question: Which of the following personalities had the key role in fighting against the British East India Company in the Battle of Porto Novo?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Hyder Ali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hyder Ali** was a prominent ruler of the **Mysore Kingdom** and known for his military tactics and administrative reforms.
 
• He played a significant role in the **Battle of Porto Novo**, which took place in **1781**, against the British East India Company.
